title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Yahoo, Doctor! Whacha doing? Looks like fun!

title: Talk 1
original: Does Rhodes Island have a karaoke place? It'd be great if we had a place to sing the night away, especially when we don't have battles to fight!

title: Talk 2
original: My job as an idol is to make the fans happy with my songs and performances. But what should I do as an operator of Rhodes Island... ?

title: Talk 3
original: Hi, hi, Doctor! Anything I can help with? Don't judge me by my look— I actually do some heavy lifting at Penguin Logistics.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Yup, my special skill is singing! I can do a cappella, lead vocals, choir singing, pop music, and I can even rap, yo yo! But, I guess that's not a very useful skill for an Operator. If only I had a more practical skill…

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: M-My ears...? Uh, I can't tell you! A-And even if you ask Texas, she's not going to tell you either! Ehhh—Sorry, I'll explain if I get the chance someday…

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: You know, Texas actually saved my life. She also taught me so much I never knew. Which is why I... want to be there with her whenever I can... I, uhh, I'm just trying to show my gratitude for her, that's all!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: You think I look upset? Um... it's because... Exusiai went on a mission with Texas again, right? If only I were as good as Exusiai…

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor! Could you teach me to use a weapon? My songs have no practical use except for support and encouragement. If I could fight with a weapon... What? You're not good at fighting either?!

title: Idle
original: Texas... are you listening to my song?

title: Onboard
original: (｡･∀･)ﾉﾞHiiii! I'm the loveable idol from Monster Siren Records: Sora! Oops, sorry, introducing myself like this at Rhodes Island must be kinda weird. Aww…

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Leveling—up!

title: Promotion 1
original: A promotion? Do we also have an idol ranking on Rhodes Island?

title: Promotion 2
original: I can feel the surge in my heart. It's like back to my first concert. I'm just delighted that you trust me so much, Doctor! All my hard work has paid off! Hmm? My ears? Wh-What about them?

title: Added to Squad
original: As a squad member, I'll try my best to learn from the basics!

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I'm the leader? Is that like standing at the center of the idol group?

title: Depart
original: Singing on the battlefield... Now that's a fresh experience!

title: Begin Operation
original: If only my music could put an end to all this fighting...

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Is it my turn?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Yes, I can handle this!

title: Deployment 1
original: It's show time!

title: Deployment 2
original: Alright, let's make some noise!

title: In Battle 1
original: Come on, we can do it!

title: In Battle 2
original: You have my full support!

title: In Battle 3
original: Now we change the game!

title: In Battle 4
original: Don't lose heart, we can win this one!

title: 4-star Result
original: I heard your cheering loud and clear, everyone! Thank you!

title: 3-star Result
original: Awesome! A smashing victory! Texas, did you see how I sparkled on the stage?

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: We did a good job, team. Thank you for your hard work!

title: Operation Failure
original: I'm sorry... I wasn't good enough to be your help...

title: Assigned to Facility
original: This place is much bigger than the dorms at Penguin Logistics!

title: Tap
original: Sparkle spark!

title: Trust Tap
original: Ehehe, thanks, Doctor!

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: It looks like I can't hold a solo live this year, but that doesn't change my desire to sing. Happy New Year! This year, I'm going to bring even more smiles to my fans—um, no, that's not the word... Oh, right! I'm going to bring even more music to everyone at Rhodes Island!

title: Greeting
original: I hope you have a fantastic day, Doctor!

title: Birthday
original: A lot of fans say my singing can bring people true happiness, and I really hope they're right. Doctor, today I've got a song just for you. Happy birthday! This is for a beautiful life and a cheerful you, all year long!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Idols and Messengers are both jobs about passing on love. Seeing fans and audiences smile is a source of happiness in my own life. I'm sure, together with everyone at Rhodes Island, we can spread this blessing even further. It's a tiny little dream, but I'll do my best to make it come true!
